decisions.reason: As the multi-variant organic flagship that embodies the firm's publicly announced organic expansion, it carries heavy strategic and reputational commitment, so management would read any softness as ramp-up and persist.

Recently launched with its own page and a public 'new in the organic team' announcement, it builds on the core Fleischwurst competence and fits the organic direction, so early results would be attributed to temporary listing and awareness effects.

A visibly announced multi-variant organic poultry line extending the firm into new formats, it represents sunk development and listing investment that management would justify by giving it more time in the market.

Close to the core salami offer and part of the organic push, it is cheap to sustain and still young, though as a single variant with less announcement it is somewhat more exposed than the flagship lines.
